# ceph_user (Resource)

Manages a Ceph Dashboard user account (RBAC) and its roles.

~> **Warning:** Managing the same dashboard account the provider authenticates as can lock the provider out (e.g. by disabling it, removing its administrator role, or deleting it). Manage a separate account for Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ceph_user" "ci" {
  username = "ci"
  password = "change-me-please"
  roles    = ["read-only"]
  name     = "CI Bot"
  email    = "ci@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive) User password. Write-only: the API never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `roles` (Set of String) Dashboard role names granted to the user, e.g. ["administrator"].
- `username` (String) Dashboard username. Changing this forces a new user.

### Optional

- `email` (String) Email address of the user.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user is enabled. Defaults to true.
- `name` (String) Full name of the user.
- `pwd_expiration_date` (Number) Password expiration date as a Unix timestamp. Unset means no expiration.
- `pwd_update_required` (Boolean) Whether the user must change their password on next login. Defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `last_update` (Number) Unix timestamp of the user's last update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Dashboard users are imported by username. The password is not returned by the
# API, so set it in configuration after import.
terraform import ceph_user.ci ci
```
